# Khaleej Times

> > Khaleej Times is a leading UAE news source covering Dubai lifestyle, arts, culture, and regional developments with focus on community stories and cultural events.

Khaleej Times provides comprehensive coverage of news, lifestyle, and cultural content from Dubai and the UAE. The site features in-depth reporting on arts and culture, community events, and regional stories affecting residents and visitors in the Emirates.

## Key Topics

- Dubai
- UAE
- Art and Culture
- Lifestyle
- Ramadan
- Artist News
- Cultural Events
- Performing Arts
- Visual Arts
- Community News

## Arts & Culture

- [Art and Culture Latest News in Dubai, UAE](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/lifestyle/arts): Latest art and culture news from Dubai and UAE covering events, visual arts, and performing arts.
